anna katarina.bio: Vancouver singer-songwriter and producer Anna Katarina makes indie pop and rock with folk and soul influences, pairing melodic songwriting with a warm, expressive vocal style.

anna sofia.bio: Toronto singer-songwriter Anna Sofia emerged as a teenager with candid alternative-pop songs built around sharp hooks, diaristic writing and understated production.

anodajay.bio: Rouyn-Noranda rapper and label founder Anodajay, born Steve Jolin, is a foundational figure in Québec hip-hop and the founder of influential imprint 7ième Ciel.

anomalie.bio: Montréal keyboardist, composer and producer Nicolas Dupuis records as Anomalie, combining jazz-fusion musicianship with funk, soul, hip-hop and electronic production.

anthony valadez.bio: Los Angeles DJ, radio host, photographer and producer Anthony Valadez is known for eclectic music curation and broadcasting work with KCRW, KROQ and other music platforms.

ap dhillon.bio: India-born, Canada-based singer, rapper and producer AP Dhillon is a leading figure in the global Punjabi music boom, blending Punjabi songwriting with hip-hop, pop and R&B production.

aquakultre.bio: Halifax singer, rapper, composer and storyteller Lance Sampson records as Aquakultre, creating genre-fluid music rooted in African Nova Scotian history, community and culture.

aqyila.bio: Toronto singer-songwriter Aqyila makes contemporary R&B and pop built around confessional writing, polished melodies and a soulful vocal style.

ar paisley.bio: Mississauga rapper AR Paisley is a Canadian hip-hop artist known for technically sharp lyricism, independent releases and collaborations across the Punjabi and Toronto-area rap scenes.

arctic monkeys.bio: Sheffield rock band Arctic Monkeys became one of the defining British guitar acts of their generation, evolving from sharp indie rock into increasingly expansive and cinematic songwriting.

ardn.bio: Ugandan-Canadian rapper ARDN is based in Edmonton and makes introspective hip-hop shaped by melodic production, personal writing and a strong independent foundation.

ari pensmith.bio: South East London singer, songwriter and producer Ari PenSmith works across R&B, Afrobeats, pop and hip-hop, both as a solo artist and a collaborator on major international releases.

ariane moffatt.bio: Montréal singer-songwriter, musician and producer Ariane Moffatt is a major figure in contemporary Québécois pop, known for French-language songwriting that moves fluidly between pop, rock and electronic music.

ariel posen.bio: Winnipeg singer-songwriter, guitarist and producer Ariel Posen balances detailed songwriting with internationally recognized guitar work spanning roots, rock, soul and contemporary singer-songwriter music.

ark identity.bio: ARK IDENTITY is the Toronto dream-pop project of singer-songwriter and multi-instrumentalist Noah Mroueh, blending psychedelic textures with melodic, atmospheric indie pop.

arman ayva.bio: Montréal-based composer and producer Arman Ayva creates instrumental jazz-fusion that blends jazz-funk, electronic production, ambient textures and world-music influences.

armin van buuren.bio: Dutch DJ and producer Armin van Buuren is one of trance music's most influential figures, known for global festival performances, a long-running recording career and the A State of Trance radio brand.

arpin lépine.bio: Québec singer-songwriter Arpin Lépine blends country, rap and bluegrass, pairing rural storytelling with banjo, slide guitar and hip-hop-informed rhythms.

ashley macisaac.bio: Cape Breton fiddler Ashley MacIsaac is a Canadian musician known for pushing traditional Celtic fiddle music into rock, pop and contemporary settings without losing its regional roots.

ashton adams.bio: Canadian DJ and producer Ashton Adams makes bass-heavy electronic and dance music while also working across hip-hop-influenced production and club releases.

asun eastwood.bio: Belize-born, Toronto-raised rapper Asun Eastwood makes sample-driven underground hip-hop built around vivid storytelling, dense lyricism and cinematic references.

b4-4.bio: Toronto pop group B4-4, later known as Before Four, was a turn-of-the-millennium Canadian boy band best known for the hit single Get Down.

bedouin soundclash.bio: Toronto-based duo Bedouin Soundclash blends reggae, indie rock, punk and world-music influences, with a catalogue that includes the Canadian hit When the Night Feels My Song.
